mapper.insert: insert into student_course( course_no, student_no, student_course_status ) values( #{courseNo}, #{studentNo}, '수강중' )
mapper.select: select SC.course_no as courseNo, SC.student_no as studentNo, SC.student_course_status as studentCourseStatus, C.course_title as courseTitle, C.course_subject as courseSubject, C.course_type as courseType, C.course_status as courseStatus from student_course SC inner join course C on SC.course_no = C.course_no where SC.student_no = #{studentNo} order by SC.course_no desc

select case -- 2. 시간표 겹침 검증 (기존과 동일하게 완벽 작동!) when ( select count(*) from schedule new_sch inner join schedule old_sch on new_sch.schedule_week = old_sch.schedule_week inner join student_course sc on old_sch.course_no = sc.course_no where new_sch.course_no = #{courseNo} and sc.student_no = #{studentNo} and sc.student_course_status in ('신청', '수강중') and new_sch.schedule_start < old_sch.schedule_end and new_sch.schedule_end > old_sch.schedule_start ) > 0 then 'TIME_CONFLICT'
-- 3. 모두 통과하면 환영합니다! else 'OK' end as validation_result from dual

select C.course_no as courseNo, C.course_title as courseTitle, C.course_subject as courseSubject, G.grade_level as gradeLevel, A.account_name as teacherName from course C inner join grade G on C.grade_no = G.grade_no inner join employee E on C.employee_no = E.employee_no inner join account A on E.account_no = A.account_no where C.course_status = '모집중' order by C.course_subject desc

select c.course_no as courseNo, c.course_title as courseTitle, c.course_subject as courseSubject, g.grade_level as gradeLevel, a.account_name as teacherName from course c inner join grade g on c.grade_no = g.grade_no inner join employee e on c.employee_no = e.employee_no inner join account a on e.account_no = a.account_no where c.course_status = '모집중' -- 겹치는 스케줄이 하나도 없는(not exists) 강의만 살아남습니다! and not exists ( select 1 from schedule target_sch inner join schedule my_sch on target_sch.schedule_week = my_sch.schedule_week inner join student_course sc on my_sch.course_no = sc.course_no where target_sch.course_no = c.course_no and sc.student_no = #{studentNo} and sc.student_course_status in ('신청', '수강중') and target_sch.schedule_start < my_sch.schedule_end and target_sch.schedule_end > my_sch.schedule_start ) order by c.course_subject desc
